sentences.text: Day 6.
Weekend Routine Mmm.
Weekends are the best.
No alarm, no rush.
I know, right?
I love sleeping in and just taking things slow.
sentences.text_ko: 늦잠 자고 천천히 보내는 게 너무 좋아.

sentences.text: What are you up to?
Just getting organized for the week.
sentences.text_ko: 이번 주 정리 좀 하고 있어.

sentences.text: Checking emails, planning meals, all that stuff.
sentences.text_ko: 이메일 확인하고, 식단 계획 세우고 그런 거지.

sentences.text: That's why you're always so on top of things.
sentences.text_ko: 그래서 네가 항상 일 처리가 깔끔한 거구나.

sentences.text: I should probably do that too.
You should.
I love meal prepping.
It makes life so much easier.
What are you up to today?
I'm going to do some chores while you meal prep.
sentences.text_ko: 너 밀프렙 하는 동안 난 집안일 좀 할게.

sentences.text: I have to take out the trash, sort the recycling, and vacuum.
sentences.text_ko: 쓰레기 버리고, 분리수거하고, 청소기 돌려야 해.

sentences.text: That's what I like to hear.
And then we can order delivery for dinner, right?
You already know.
Weekends aren't complete without ordering in and watching our favorite show.
sentences.text_ko: 주말엔 배달 시켜서 좋아하는 거 보지 않으면 섭섭해.
